**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error: **

The company needs a detailed feedback (1)/ from all departments (2)/ before finalising its restructuring plan (3)/ for the upcoming fiscal year. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. The company needs a detailed feedback .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "a detailed feedback". The word "feedback" is an uncountable noun and does not require the article "a".
 
• The correct phrase should be "detailed feedback".
 
• Uncountable nouns like "feedback" cannot have articles like "a" or "an" before them.

Correct sentence: *The company needs detailed feedback from all departments before finalising its restructuring plan for the upcoming fiscal year*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uncountable nouns:**

 
 
• These are nouns that cannot be counted and do not have plural forms.
 
• Examples include "information," "advice," "feedback," "equipment," and "furniture".
 
• Articles like "a" or "an" are not used with uncountable nouns.
 
 
 
• **Common errors with uncountable nouns:**
 
 
• Using "a" or "an" incorrectly.
 
• Trying to make them plural (e.g., "feedbacks" is incorrect).
